title: iVSR Model Config
description: Descriptor file for iVSR models loaded via model_type=-1. Covers tensor layout, precision, frame count, alignment, window strategy and normalisation.

name.description: Human-readable model label used in log messages

nif.description: Number of input frames consumed per inference call (1 = single frame)

align.description: Round input width and height up to a multiple of this value (0 = no alignment)

in_precision.description: Input tensor element type (null = inherit from frame bit-depth)

out_precision.description: Output tensor element type (null = default fp32)

model_color.description: Colour space string reported to iVSR SDK. null = determined by color_format_auto

out_order.description: Output channel order for the ffmpeg proc helper

window_type.description: Frame queuing strategy: single (no queue), sliding (N-frame window), in_queue (read nif frames from task queue - BasicVSR style)

window_init_dup.description: When window_type=sliding: duplicate first frame to prime the queue (TSENet). false = wait for queue to fill (RIFE)

normalize_input.description: Divide uint8 pixel values by 255 before packing into float32 (RIFE/SPAN). false = raw [0,255] (VideoSeal)

normalize_output.description: Multiply float32 output by 255 then clip to uint8 (RIFE/SPAN). false = direct round-and-clip (VideoSeal)

output_passthrough_dims.description: Report output W/H = input W/H regardless of tensor (VideoProc passthrough models)

out_precision_depth_derived.description: Derive output precision from frame bit depth: u8 for 8-bit, u16 for 10/16-bit (EDSR style)

color_format_auto.description: 0 = use model_color. 1 = VideoProc-auto (RGB vs I420 from pixel format). 2 = CustVSR-auto (always I420)
